function: Learned estimation of the equivalent delay-Doppler CSI (ECSIEst-Net, unfolded SBL) and CSI-free detection of secondary IRS symbols (SSymDet-Net, CNN classifier) in an OTFS symbiotic radio (p. 8-9).
system: Downlink OTFS symbiotic radio: single-antenna primary BS and receiver, reflecting IRS secondary emitter 10x10 (phase fixed, frequency-modulated), 28 GHz, 20 MHz, 60 kHz spacing (p. 3-4, 10).
method: Deep unfolding of off-grid SBL into ECSIEst-Net (K=3 layers, 2D-CNN per layer, MSE loss) and a CNN classifier SSymDet-Net (cross-entropy); both supervised, trained offline (p. 8-10).
data_channel: Custom simulated delay-Doppler multipath channels, complex Gaussian gains, up to 3 paths per tap, 28 GHz; one dataset split 7:2:1; no 3GPP model or measurements (p. 4, 9-10).
test_conditions: Trained offline, tested on the held-out 10% of the same simulated dataset; sweeps over SNR, N, paths, delay taps, IRS size; no train-test mismatch stated (p. 10-12).
baselines: Estimation: LS, PC-SBL, off-grid SBL (non-learned) and a CNN data-driven estimator [57] (learned); detection: off-grid SBL detector and ML detector only, no learned baseline (p. 11-12).
metrics: NMSE of the equivalent CSI, BER of secondary symbols, validation loss, FLOPs (p. 10-12).
complexity: FLOPs at default parameters: off-grid SBL 319.5 GFLOPs, SSymDet-Net 84.74 MFLOPs, ECSIEst-Net 59.83 MFLOPs (p. 12).
openness: none; no code or data link (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 9: "The complex gains of the channel g follows the" Gaussian distribution; p. 10: Table I lists a 28 GHz carrier. A custom delay-Doppler simulator; no 3GPP model, public dataset, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 10: "The total dataset is divided into training, validation, and testing sets in a 7:2:1 ratio", so the test set is held-out data of the same simulation; pp. 10-12 sweeps give no model tested outside its training setting.
q3_support: p. 11: "Data-driven method in [57]" is the CNN learned baseline, and "data-driven methods by effectively incorporating prior system knowledge" is the comparison; p. 11: "ECSIEst-Net demonstrates superior performance compared to off-grid SBL methods".
q4_support: p. 12: "SSymDet-Net and ECSIEst-Net require 84.74 MFLOPs (Mega FLOPs) and 59.83 MFLOPs"; the off-grid SBL method requires 319.5 GFLOPs.
q5_support: p. 9: "The complex gains of the channel g follows the" distribution, so the data are simulated by the authors. No link, DOI, public dataset, or code release is stated.
notes: Area 4 by the order of specificity: ECSIEst-Net estimates the equivalent delay-Doppler CSI and SSymDet-Net detects the IRS frequency-combination symbol. The IRS is a reflecting secondary emitter with fixed phases (diag(theta)=I), so ris=1. q3 rests on the estimation comparison with a CNN data-driven estimator (Fig. 7); SSymDet-Net is compared only with non-learned off-grid SBL and ML detectors (Figs. 8-10).
